title: NCR Atleos launches ATM for retailers
snippet: NCR Atleos Corporation (NYSE: NATL) (“Atleos”), a leader in expanding self-service financial access for financial institutions, retailers and consumers, today announced AllTM, an ATM solution that helps US retailers transform the ATM from a traditional cash access point into a powerful driver of foot traffic, customer engagement and revenue growth through expanded capabilities.

title: PayFacto intergrates Interac Konek digital wallet across merchant network

title: Gnosis Pay data breach exposes customer info; funds unaffected

title: Russia finalizes crypto trading rules ahead of Nov. 17 rollout

title: Interview: Infineon's first RISC-V automotive MCU is built for a decade-plus production run
snippet: Infineon Technologies is betting on RISC-V scalability with AURIX RC1, its first RISC-V-based microcontroller (MCU) platform, unveiled this week. A single instruction set lets the platform span everything from very small controllers to real-time vehicle computers and robotic motion controllers, so RC1 can serve automotive, robotics, and industrial customers at the same time.
